n: DM NAX® 8K Smart Display Controller and Network Audio Encoder/Decoder (DM-NAX-XSP)
d: DM-NAX-XSP DM NAX® 8K Smart Display Controller and Network Audio Encoder/Decoder with eARC Support

specs.label: Audio output signal types
specs.value: HDMI (multichannel pass-through), DM NAX (2-channel downmix), AES67 audio-over-IP (2-channel downmix)

specs.label: Audio digital formats
specs.value: Dolby Digital®, Dolby Digital EX, Dolby Digital Plus, Dolby TrueHD, Dolby Atmos

specs.label: Input Signal Types
specs.value: HDMI with HDR10, HDR10+, Dolby Vision, Deep Color, 8K30 4:4:4 12-bit, and 4K120 4:4:4 12-bit support

specs.label: Output Signal Types
specs.value: HDMI with HDR10, HDR10+, Dolby Vision, Deep Color, 8K30 4:4:4 12-bit, and 4K120 4:4:4 12-bit support

specs.label: Ethernet
specs.value: For control, and/or console, 100/1000 Mbps, auto-switching, auto-negotiating, auto-discovery, full/half duplex, DHCP

specs.label: IR
specs.value: 1-way device control via infrared up to 1.1 MHz or serial TTL (0-5V) up to 19.2k baud via control system

specs.label: PoE+
specs.value: IEEE 802.3at Type 2 Class 4 (25.5 W) compliant; Compatible with Crestron DM-PSU-ULTRA-MIDSPAN, PoE+ compliant Ethernet switch, or third-party IEEE 802.3at compliant PSE

specs.label: Mounting
specs.value: Surface-mountable or attachable to a single rack rail
